site.title: CoMeBench
site.tagline: A Contract-Structured Benchmark for Memory-Dependent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

sections.heading: Why CoMeBench
paragraphs: **CoMeBench** is a benchmark for …. It provides a unified, reproducible evaluation protocol so that results across papers are directly comparable, and it ships with a public dataset, evaluation scripts and a maintained leaderboard.

Write two or three sentences on the gap you are filling: what existing benchmarks miss, and what CoMeBench does differently. Keep it concrete — a number or a concrete failure mode of prior work reads far better than an adjective.
Every task is language-conditioned, and the whole suite can be run locally in under an hour on a single GPU.

items.title: Controlled difficulty
items.text: Each task varies one factor at a time, so a score drop can be attributed to a specific capability instead of being an average over confounded settings.

items.title: Automatic scoring
items.text: Every instance has a programmatic checker, so evaluation needs no human judges and runs identically on any machine.

items.title: Held-out split
items.text: A hidden test split guards against overfitting to the public leaderboard, with a submission server for blind evaluation.

sections.heading: The task suite
sections.description: The suite includes 12 general loco-manipulation tasks, 4 memory-dependent tasks, and 4 long-horizon tasks.

sections.heading: Every keyframe is a skill boundary
sections.description: Operators mark a keyframe the moment a subtask completes, splitting each trajectory into temporally aligned segments. Each segment carries a subtask name and a fine-grained description, while each task carries both a task-level instruction and a step-wise instruction. Because segments are tied to the task graph, a keyframe is not just a timestamp — it is a skill instance with its own assumptions, invariants, and guarantees.

items.title: Take the basket out of the cabinet
items.prompt: Kneel on one knee, pick up the basket with both hands, stand up, put it on the counter and lower both arms.

subtasks.name: Grasp the basket with both hands
Place it on the counter and release it

items.title: Retrieve blocks from cups, then open the blue cup
items.prompt: Wait for the operator to place blocks under inverted cups. Pick up the cup covering the red block, retrieve the red block, carry it to the cart, place it in the basket, return to the table, and lift the cup covering the blue block.

items.title: Clean the living room
items.prompt: Push the small cart from the center of the living room to the area in front of the sofa's left side. Turn right to face the sofa and inspect the room. Complete only the cleanup tasks required by the current scene: restore any fallen cushions, dispose of any trash on the coffee table, and, if an uncollected book is on the sofa and a used coffee cup is on the coffee table, pick up both items and leave the sofa area. Place the coffee cup in the cart's storage basket and the book in an empty space on the bookshelf. After all required tasks are complete, return to the cart and push it beside the cabinet.

subtasks.text: Push the small cart from the center of the living room to the area in front of the sofa's left side. Turn right to face the sofa.

subtasks.name: Restore the near cushion
subtasks.text: If a cushion has fallen near the sofa, pick it up and place it on the sofa.

subtasks.name: Throw trash
subtasks.text: If trash is present on the coffee table, bring the trash bin, pick up the trash, and throw it into the bin.

subtasks.name: Restore the far cushion
subtasks.text: If another cushion has fallen on the far side, walk to it, pick it up, and place it on the sofa.

subtasks.name: Collect the book and cup
subtasks.text: If an uncollected book is on the sofa and a used coffee cup is on the coffee table, pick up both items securely.

subtasks.name: Place the cup
subtasks.text: Place the coffee cup in the cart's storage basket and release it.

subtasks.name: Place the book
subtasks.text: Carry the book to the bookshelf and place it in an empty space.

subtasks.name: Store the cart
subtasks.text: Return to the cart and push it beside the cabinet for storage.

sections.heading: Run it in four steps
sections.code:
# 1. get the code
git clone https://github.com/<org>/CoMeBench
cd CoMeBench

# 2. install dependencies
pip install -e .

# 3. download the data
python scripts/download.py --root ./data

# 4. evaluate your model
python eval.py --model your-model --split test
